name: JoAi: Create Project

description.en: Create a new project for your agent to organize work, content production, or ongoing initiatives.
description.de: Erstelle ein neues Projekt für deinen Agenten, um Arbeit, Content-Produktion oder laufende Initiativen zu organisieren.
description.es: Create a new project for your agent to organize work, content production, or ongoing initiatives.
description.fr: Create a new project for your agent to organize work, content production, or ongoing initiatives.
description.ro: Create a new project for your agent to organize work, content production, or ongoing initiatives.
description.it: Create a new project for your agent to organize work, content production, or ongoing initiatives.

bot: Use this when the user wants to start a new project. Help them define a clear name and purpose.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.bot: A concise name for this project (e.g., 'Q2 Marketing Campaign', 'Product Launch').

inputs.name: Brief

description.en: Creative brief or description of this project
description.es: Creative brief or description of this project
description.fr: Creative brief or description of this project
description.ro: Creative brief or description of this project
description.it: Creative brief or description of this project

inputs.bot: A short creative brief outlining this project's goals and scope.

inputs.name: Output Preset

description.en: Output preset: 9:16 social, 16:9 launch, or 1:1 square teaser.
description.de: Ausgabe-Preset: 9:16 Social, 16:9 Launch oder 1:1 quadratischer Teaser.

inputs.bot: Optional output preset. One of: 9:16 social, 16:9 launch, 1:1 square teaser.

inputs.name: Target Platforms

description.en: Target platforms as a JSON array, e.g. ["instagram","tiktok"].

inputs.bot: Optional JSON array of target platform names.

inputs.name: Selected Skills

description.en: Skill IDs to attach as a JSON array, e.g. ["skill-id"].
description.de: Skill-IDs zum Anhängen als JSON-Array, z.B. ["skill-id"].

inputs.bot: Optional JSON array of skill IDs to attach to this project.

inputs.name: Template

description.en: Render the project from a template element variation
description.es: Renderizar el proyecto a partir de una variación de plantilla
description.fr: Générer le projet à partir d'une variation de modèle
description.ro: Randează proiectul dintr-o variație de șablon
description.it: Genera il progetto da una variazione del modello

inputs.bot: Optional JSON: {"elementVariationId": "...", "mode": "light"|"dark", "values": {field: value}}. Makes this an image project rendered directly from the template.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
